---
title: "Alternative-splicing event classification of CAD sQTL clusters"
output: html_document
---

## Purpose

Each CAD-colocalized sQTL identifies a LeafCutter cluster of mutually exclusive
intron-excision events, but the cluster alone does not say what kind of splicing
change the risk allele produces. This script assigns one of the nine
alternative-splicing (AS) classes (exon skipping, alternative donor or acceptor
site, mutually exclusive exons, intron retention, alternative first or last exon
and their mutually exclusive variants), plus "complex" for clusters that fit no
single pattern, to every CAD-associated cluster and to every non-CAD VSMC sQTL
cluster used as background. Three classifiers are run because each sees a
different part of the evidence: (A) the coordinates of the risk and nonrisk
junctions resolve shared donors and acceptors; (B) the topology of all junctions
in the cluster, together with internal exons from GENCODE v38 and the long-read
models, resolves cassette and mutually exclusive exons; and (C) exon-by-exon
comparison of the paired long-read transcripts resolves events, such as
alternative first or last exons, that need transcript context. The three calls
are reconciled to one consensus label per cluster. Because the manuscript asks
whether CAD-associated events alter the protein, the script also records a
predicted protein consequence for each risk/nonrisk junction pair, using the
single coding definition exported by `02_junction_isoform_mapping_and_pairs.Rmd`
so that every downstream script stratifies junctions identically.

## Manuscript outputs produced

- Extended Data Fig. 5a — AS class distribution, CAD versus non-CAD VSMC sQTL
  clusters (data table; the panel is drawn by `10_figure_and_table_generation.Rmd`).
- Fig. 4e — predicted protein consequence of the long-read-captured CAD sQTL
  junctions (per-junction-pair effects; collapsed to one call per junction in
  script 10).
- Supplementary Table 14 — AS event classification per cluster (consensus table).
- Methods, "Alternative-splicing event classification".

## Inputs

- `OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_PAIRS`, `OUT_CAD_CLUSTER_SIBLINGS`, `OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED`,
  `OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING`, `OUT_NONCAD_JUNCTION_CODING`, `OUT_JUNCTION_UNIVERSE`
  — risk/nonrisk junction pairs, cluster membership, isoform pairs and the
  junction coding classification from script 02.
- `OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED` — the integrated CAD sQTL junction table from script 01
  (defines the CAD junction universe and the CAD clusters excluded from the
  background).
- `F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR` — all VSMC sQTL junctions (non-CAD background).
- `F_SMC_GTF` — long-read VSMC transcript models (exon structure of the paired
  isoforms).
- `F_GENCODE_V38_GTF` — GENCODE v38 annotation (first, last and internal exons).
- `F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_PROLIF`, `F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_QUIESC` — LeafCutter cluster BEDs
  (all junctions of the non-CAD clusters).

## Outputs (in `RES_04`)

- `as_event_classification_consensus.csv` — per-cluster calls from methods A, B
  and C and the consensus (Supplementary Table 14; read by script 10).
- `as_type_distribution_cad_vs_noncad.csv` — cluster counts per AS class for CAD
  and non-CAD clusters (Extended Data Fig. 5a; read by script 10).
- `protein_effects_per_junction.csv` — predicted protein consequence per
  risk/nonrisk junction pair (Fig. 4e and Supplementary Table 13; read by
  script 10).

## Run order

Scripts 01 and 02 must have been run.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("config.R")
library(tidyverse)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(rtracklayer)
library(data.table)

set.seed(42)
ensure_dir(RES_04)

require_files(OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_PAIRS, OUT_CAD_CLUSTER_SIBLINGS, OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED,
              OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING, OUT_NONCAD_JUNCTION_CODING, OUT_JUNCTION_UNIVERSE,
              OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR, F_SMC_GTF, F_GENCODE_V38_GTF,
              F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_PROLIF, F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_QUIESC)

# A junction is coding when script 02 labelled it "CDS (at least partial)": it
# overlaps a CDS feature and at least one long-read isoform containing it is
# coding. This single label is the coding filter shared by scripts 02-06 and 10.
CODING_CLASS_KEEP <- "CDS (at least partial)"

# Parse a "chr:start:end" junction key into its components (NA-safe).
parse_junction_key <- function(jk) {
  jk <- as.character(jk)
  parts <- str_split_fixed(jk, ":", 3)
  parts[is.na(jk), ] <- NA_character_
  tibble(chr   = as.character(parts[, 1]),
         start = suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[, 2])),
         end   = suppressWarnings(as.integer(parts[, 3])))
}
```

# 1. Load data

The CAD side of the analysis is built entirely from script 02's exports, so the
pairs, cluster membership and isoform pairs are the same objects used for the
property and peptide analyses. Exon annotations are taken from both GENCODE v38
and the long-read models because LeafCutter frequently captures the two flanking
introns of a cassette exon without the skip junction; recognizing that signature
requires knowing that an annotated internal exon sits in the gap between them.

```{r load_data}
pairs_df  <- read_csv(OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_PAIRS,   show_col_types = FALSE)
siblings  <- read_csv(OUT_CAD_CLUSTER_SIBLINGS, show_col_types = FALSE)
iso_pairs <- read_csv(OUT_PAIRS_UNIFIED_FLAGGED, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot("isoform pair table must carry cluster_bed" =
            "cluster_bed" %in% names(iso_pairs) && any(!is.na(iso_pairs$cluster_bed)))
message(sprintf("CAD junction pairs: %d | sibling junctions: %d in %d clusters | isoform pairs: %d",
                nrow(pairs_df), nrow(siblings), n_distinct(siblings$cluster_bed), nrow(iso_pairs)))

# ---- long-read transcript models: exons per PB isoform (sorted by genomic start) ----
smc_gtf <- rtracklayer::import(F_SMC_GTF)
seqlevelsStyle(smc_gtf) <- "UCSC"
smc_exons <- smc_gtf[smc_gtf$type == "exon"]
smc_exons$pb_id <- str_extract(smc_exons$transcript_id, "PB\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+")
smc_exons <- smc_exons[!is.na(smc_exons$pb_id)]
smc_exons_by_pb <- endoapply(split(smc_exons, smc_exons$pb_id), sort)

# ---- GENCODE v38: first, last and internal exons per transcript ----
gencode <- rtracklayer::import(F_GENCODE_V38_GTF)
seqlevelsStyle(gencode) <- "UCSC"
gencode_exons <- gencode[gencode$type == "exon"]
ex_df <- as.data.frame(gencode_exons) %>%
  mutate(exon_n = suppressWarnings(as.integer(exon_number))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(exon_n))

gencode_first_exon <- gencode_exons[gencode_exons$exon_number == "1"]
last_idx <- ex_df %>% group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(exon_n == max(exon_n)) %>% ungroup()
gencode_last_exon <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(last_idx, keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
seqlevelsStyle(gencode_last_exon) <- "UCSC"
internal_idx <- ex_df %>%
  group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(exon_n > 1 & exon_n < max(exon_n)) %>% ungroup()
gencode_internal_exon <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(internal_idx, keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
seqlevelsStyle(gencode_internal_exon) <- "UCSC"

# ---- long-read internal exons (exon_number when present, otherwise genomic order) ----
smc_internal_exon <- {
  smc_ex_df <- as.data.frame(smc_exons)
  has_exon_n <- "exon_number" %in% colnames(smc_ex_df)
  if (has_exon_n) {
    smc_ex_df <- smc_ex_df %>% mutate(exon_n = suppressWarnings(as.integer(exon_number)))
    has_exon_n <- any(!is.na(smc_ex_df$exon_n))
  }
  int_smc <- if (has_exon_n) {
    smc_ex_df %>% filter(!is.na(exon_n)) %>%
      group_by(transcript_id) %>% filter(exon_n > 1 & exon_n < max(exon_n)) %>% ungroup()
  } else {
    smc_ex_df %>% group_by(transcript_id) %>% arrange(start, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
      mutate(rank_idx = row_number(), max_rank = max(rank_idx)) %>%
      filter(rank_idx > 1 & rank_idx < max_rank) %>% ungroup()
  }
  if (nrow(int_smc) > 0) {
    g <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(int_smc, keep.extra.columns = TRUE)
    seqlevelsStyle(g) <- "UCSC"
    g
  } else GRanges()
}

# Internal exons from both annotations are pooled for cassette-inclusion detection.
internal_exon_gr <- c(gencode_internal_exon, smc_internal_exon)
message(sprintf("internal exons for inclusion detection: %d (GENCODE %d + long-read %d)",
                length(internal_exon_gr), length(gencode_internal_exon), length(smc_internal_exon)))

# ---- non-CAD VSMC sQTL background ----
# Every cluster present in the integrated CAD sQTL table is removed from the
# background, using the same exclusion key as script 02.
general_sqtls <- read_tsv(F_GENERAL_SQTL_LR, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"))
lfc_final <- read_tsv(OUT_LFC_INTEGRATED, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(junction_key = paste(chr, intron_start, intron_end, sep = ":"))
stopifnot("cluster column expected in the integrated sQTL table" = "cluster" %in% names(lfc_final))
cad_cluster_set <- unique(lfc_final$cluster)
general_sqtls <- general_sqtls %>% filter(!cluster_id %in% cad_cluster_set)
message(sprintf("non-CAD VSMC sQTL junctions after excluding %d CAD clusters: %d",
                length(cad_cluster_set), nrow(general_sqtls)))

# ---- LeafCutter BEDs: all junctions of every cluster (non-CAD cluster topology) ----
parse_bed <- function(path, cond) {
  bed <- fread(file = path, select = 1:4, header = TRUE)
  colnames(bed) <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "ID")
  as_tibble(bed) %>%
    mutate(junction_key = paste0(chrom, ":", start, ":", end),
           cluster_bed  = str_extract(ID, "clu_\\d+_[+-]"),
           strand       = str_sub(cluster_bed, -1, -1),
           condition    = cond) %>%
    select(junction_key, cluster_bed, chrom, start, end, strand, condition)
}
bed_all <- bind_rows(parse_bed(F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_PROLIF, "Proliferative"),
                     parse_bed(F_LEAFCUTTER_BED_QUIESC, "Quiescent")) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, cluster_bed, .keep_all = TRUE)
```

# 2. Junction universe and coding status

The distinct CAD sQTL junctions are taken from the integrated sQTL table and
annotated with their provenance (GENCODE v38, long-read, both or neither) and
with the coding label exported by script 02. The coding status is asserted to
agree with script 02's full junction universe, because a disagreement here would
make the coding stratification of this script diverge from the peptide and
property analyses.

```{r junction_annotation}
unified_coding <- read_csv(OUT_CAD_JUNCTION_CODING, show_col_types = FALSE)

junction_annot <- lfc_final %>%
  distinct(junction_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(in_lr = !is.na(smc_isoforms) & smc_isoforms != "",
         in_gc = !is.na(gencode_v38_isoforms) & gencode_v38_isoforms != "",
         provenance = case_when( in_gc &  in_lr ~ "both",
                                 in_gc & !in_lr ~ "gencode_only",
                                !in_gc &  in_lr ~ "lr_only",
                                TRUE            ~ "neither")) %>%
  left_join(unified_coding %>% select(junction_key, overlaps_cds, any_coding, coding_class),
            by = "junction_key") %>%
  mutate(in_cds_isoform = coding_class %in% CODING_CLASS_KEEP)
message(sprintf("distinct CAD sQTL junctions: %d | in long-read isoform: %d | coding: %d",
                nrow(junction_annot), sum(junction_annot$in_lr), sum(junction_annot$in_cds_isoform)))

# Coding status must match script 02's exported universe on every shared junction.
as_universe_02 <- read_csv(OUT_JUNCTION_UNIVERSE, show_col_types = FALSE)
cmp <- junction_annot %>%
  transmute(junction_key, coding_here = in_cds_isoform) %>%
  inner_join(as_universe_02 %>% filter(set == "CAD") %>%
               transmute(junction_key, coding_02 = coding_class %in% CODING_CLASS_KEEP),
             by = "junction_key")
stopifnot("no junctions shared with the script-02 universe" = nrow(cmp) > 0,
          "coding status differs from script 02" = all(cmp$coding_here == cmp$coding_02))
```

# 3. Classifiers

## 3a. Method A — pairwise junction classifier

Two introns on the same chromosome and strand are compared on genomic
coordinates (start = lower coordinate), so the donor/acceptor assignment depends
on strand: on the + strand the start is the donor and the end the acceptor, and
the reverse on the − strand. A shared endpoint gives an alternative splice site,
strict containment gives exon skipping with an explicit skip junction, and two
non-overlapping junctions are called exon skipping when an annotated internal
exon lies entirely in the gap between them (the inclusion signature of a
cassette), AFE/ALE when a donor or acceptor sits in an annotated first or last
exon, and complex otherwise.

```{r fn_classify_pair}
classify_junction_pair <- function(s_a, e_a, s_b, e_b, strand,
                                   first_exon_gr = NULL, last_exon_gr = NULL,
                                   internal_exon_gr = NULL, chr = NULL) {
  if (any(is.na(c(s_a, e_a, s_b, e_b)))) {
    return(tibble(as_type = NA_character_, confidence = "missing",
                  reason = "NA junction coordinates", sub_event = NA_character_))
  }
  if (s_a == s_b && e_a == e_b) {
    return(tibble(as_type = "no_event", confidence = "high",
                  reason = "junctions identical", sub_event = NA_character_))
  }
  shared_start <- (s_a == s_b)
  shared_end   <- (e_a == e_b)

  # Shared endpoint: alternative acceptor (AAS) or donor (ADS) site
  if (shared_start && !shared_end) {
    as_type <- if (strand == "+") "AAS" else "ADS"
    return(tibble(as_type = as_type, confidence = "high",
                  reason = sprintf("shared %s; alt %s",
                                   if (strand == "+") "donor" else "acceptor",
                                   if (strand == "+") "acceptor" else "donor"),
                  sub_event = NA_character_))
  }
  if (!shared_start && shared_end) {
    as_type <- if (strand == "+") "ADS" else "AAS"
    return(tibble(as_type = as_type, confidence = "high",
                  reason = sprintf("shared %s; alt %s",
                                   if (strand == "+") "acceptor" else "donor",
                                   if (strand == "+") "donor" else "acceptor"),
                  sub_event = NA_character_))
  }

  # Containment: the longer junction skips the cassette exon, the shorter is one inclusion arm
  a_contains_b <- (s_a < s_b) && (e_a > e_b)
  b_contains_a <- (s_a > s_b) && (e_a < e_b)
  if (a_contains_b || b_contains_a) {
    return(tibble(as_type = "ES", confidence = "high",
                  reason = "one junction strictly contains the other (skip + inclusion arm)",
                  sub_event = "skip_plus_inclusion"))
  }

  # Non-overlapping junctions: cassette inclusion, AFE/ALE, or complex
  nonoverlap <- (e_a < s_b) || (e_b < s_a)
  if (nonoverlap) {
    if (e_a < s_b) { j1_end <- e_a; j2_start <- s_b } else { j1_end <- e_b; j2_start <- s_a }
    gap_lo <- j1_end + 1
    gap_hi <- j2_start - 1

    if (!is.null(internal_exon_gr) && !is.null(chr) && gap_lo <= gap_hi) {
      gap_gr <- GRanges(chr, IRanges(gap_lo, gap_hi), strand = strand)
      # An exon contained within the gap (not merely overlapping it) is a cassette exon
      cassette_hits <- countOverlaps(internal_exon_gr, gap_gr, type = "within") > 0
      if (any(cassette_hits)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "ES", confidence = "high",
                      reason = "non-overlapping junctions flank an annotated internal exon (cassette inclusion)",
                      sub_event = "inclusion_only"))
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(first_exon_gr) && !is.null(chr)) {
      donor_gr <- GRanges(chr, IRanges(c(s_a, s_b) - 1, c(s_a, s_b) + 1), strand = strand)
      if (any(countOverlaps(donor_gr, first_exon_gr) > 0)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "AFE", confidence = "medium",
                      reason = "non-overlapping junctions; donor at annotated first exon",
                      sub_event = NA_character_))
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(last_exon_gr) && !is.null(chr)) {
      acc_gr <- GRanges(chr, IRanges(c(e_a, e_b) - 1, c(e_a, e_b) + 1), strand = strand)
      if (any(countOverlaps(acc_gr, last_exon_gr) > 0)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "ALE", confidence = "medium",
                      reason = "non-overlapping junctions; acceptor at annotated last exon",
                      sub_event = NA_character_))
      }
    }
    return(tibble(as_type = "complex", confidence = "low",
                  reason = "non-overlapping junctions, no exon in gap and no AFE/ALE match",
                  sub_event = NA_character_))
  }

  # Partial overlap without a shared splice site
  tibble(as_type = "complex", confidence = "low",
         reason = "overlapping but no shared splice site", sub_event = NA_character_)
}
```

## 3b. Method B — cluster topology classifier

All junctions of one LeafCutter cluster are examined together, which is the only
way to see patterns that a single junction pair cannot show: a three-junction
cassette (skip junction plus two inclusion arms), the four-junction signature of
mutually exclusive exons (two shared flanks enclosing two non-overlapping
cassettes), and multi-way alternative splice sites. Clusters of four or more
junctions that match no exact pattern are classified by the dominant pairwise
evidence (containment or inclusion versus shared splice sites).

```{r fn_classify_cluster}
classify_cluster_topology <- function(junctions_df, first_exon_gr = NULL, last_exon_gr = NULL,
                                      internal_exon_gr = NULL) {
  n <- nrow(junctions_df)
  strand <- unique(junctions_df$strand)
  if (length(strand) != 1) strand <- strand[1]
  chr <- unique(junctions_df$chrom)[1]

  if (n < 2) {
    return(tibble(as_type = NA_character_, n_junctions = n, confidence = "missing",
                  reason = "cluster has < 2 junctions"))
  }
  jdf <- junctions_df %>% arrange(start, end)
  s <- jdf$start; e <- jdf$end

  has_exon_in_gap <- function(gap_lo, gap_hi) {
    if (is.null(internal_exon_gr) || is.na(chr) || gap_lo > gap_hi) return(FALSE)
    gap_gr <- GRanges(chr, IRanges(gap_lo, gap_hi), strand = strand)
    any(countOverlaps(internal_exon_gr, gap_gr, type = "within") > 0)
  }

  # ---- two junctions ----
  if (n == 2) {
    if (s[1] == s[2] && e[1] != e[2]) {
      as_type <- if (strand == "+") "AAS" else "ADS"
      return(tibble(as_type = as_type, n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                    reason = "2 junctions sharing donor end"))
    }
    if (e[1] == e[2] && s[1] != s[2]) {
      as_type <- if (strand == "+") "ADS" else "AAS"
      return(tibble(as_type = as_type, n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                    reason = "2 junctions sharing acceptor end"))
    }
    if ((s[1] < s[2] && e[1] > e[2]) || (s[2] < s[1] && e[2] > e[1])) {
      return(tibble(as_type = "ES", n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                    reason = "2 junctions, one contains the other (skip + inclusion arm)"))
    }
    if (e[1] < s[2] && has_exon_in_gap(e[1] + 1, s[2] - 1)) {
      return(tibble(as_type = "ES", n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                    reason = "2 non-overlapping junctions flanking an annotated internal exon (cassette inclusion)"))
    }
    if (!is.null(first_exon_gr) && !is.na(chr)) {
      donor_gr <- GRanges(chr, IRanges(c(s[1], s[2]) - 1, c(s[1], s[2]) + 1), strand = strand)
      if (any(countOverlaps(donor_gr, first_exon_gr) > 0)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "AFE", n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                      reason = "2 non-overlapping junctions; donor at annotated first exon"))
      }
    }
    if (!is.null(last_exon_gr) && !is.na(chr)) {
      acc_gr <- GRanges(chr, IRanges(c(e[1], e[2]) - 1, c(e[1], e[2]) + 1), strand = strand)
      if (any(countOverlaps(acc_gr, last_exon_gr) > 0)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "ALE", n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                      reason = "2 non-overlapping junctions; acceptor at annotated last exon"))
      }
    }
    return(tibble(as_type = "complex", n_junctions = n, confidence = "low",
                  reason = "2 junctions, no cassette/AFE/ALE match"))
  }

  # ---- three junctions ----
  if (n == 3) {
    # Canonical cassette: one skip junction spanning two inclusion junctions
    skip_idx <- which(s == min(s) & e == max(e))
    if (length(skip_idx) == 1) {
      others <- jdf[-skip_idx, ]
      shares_start <- others$start == s[skip_idx]
      shares_end   <- others$end   == e[skip_idx]
      if (sum(shares_start) == 1 && sum(shares_end) == 1 && !any(shares_start & shares_end)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "ES", n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                      reason = "3-junction cassette: skip + two flanking inclusion junctions"))
      }
    }
    if (length(unique(s)) == 1) {
      as_type <- if (strand == "+") "AAS" else "ADS"
      return(tibble(as_type = as_type, n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                    reason = "3 junctions sharing one endpoint (multi-way alt splice site)"))
    }
    if (length(unique(e)) == 1) {
      as_type <- if (strand == "+") "ADS" else "AAS"
      return(tibble(as_type = as_type, n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                    reason = "3 junctions sharing one endpoint (multi-way alt splice site)"))
    }
    for (i in 1:2) for (j in (i + 1):3) {
      if ((s[i] < s[j] && e[i] > e[j]) || (s[j] < s[i] && e[j] > e[i])) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "ES", n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                      reason = "3-junction cluster with one pair showing containment (likely cassette)"))
      }
      if (e[i] < s[j] && has_exon_in_gap(e[i] + 1, s[j] - 1)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "ES", n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                      reason = "3-junction cluster with one pair flanking an internal exon (cassette inclusion)"))
      }
      if (e[j] < s[i] && has_exon_in_gap(e[j] + 1, s[i] - 1)) {
        return(tibble(as_type = "ES", n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                      reason = "3-junction cluster with one pair flanking an internal exon (cassette inclusion)"))
      }
    }
    return(tibble(as_type = "complex", n_junctions = n, confidence = "low",
                  reason = "3-junction cluster, no clean ES / A5SS / A3SS pattern"))
  }

  # ---- four junctions: mutually exclusive exons ----
  if (n == 4) {
    n_share_min_s <- sum(s == min(s))
    n_share_max_e <- sum(e == max(e))
    if (n_share_min_s == 2 && n_share_max_e == 2) {
      ups   <- jdf %>% filter(start == min(s)) %>% arrange(end)
      downs <- jdf %>% filter(end   == max(e)) %>% arrange(start)
      if (nrow(ups) == 2 && nrow(downs) == 2) {
        cas_A <- c(ups$end[1] + 1, downs$start[1] - 1)
        cas_B <- c(ups$end[2] + 1, downs$start[2] - 1)
        if (cas_A[2] < cas_B[1] || cas_B[2] < cas_A[1]) {
          return(tibble(as_type = "MXE", n_junctions = n, confidence = "high",
                        reason = "4-junction MXE: two non-overlapping cassettes between shared flanks"))
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # ---- four or more junctions: dominant pairwise evidence ----
  n_contain <- 0L; n_inclusion <- 0L; n_share_s <- 0L; n_share_e <- 0L
  for (i in 1:(n - 1)) for (j in (i + 1):n) {
    if (s[i] == s[j] && e[i] != e[j]) n_share_s <- n_share_s + 1L
    if (e[i] == e[j] && s[i] != s[j]) n_share_e <- n_share_e + 1L
    if ((s[i] < s[j] && e[i] > e[j]) || (s[j] < s[i] && e[j] > e[i])) n_contain <- n_contain + 1L
    if (e[i] < s[j] && has_exon_in_gap(e[i] + 1, s[j] - 1)) n_inclusion <- n_inclusion + 1L
    if (e[j] < s[i] && has_exon_in_gap(e[j] + 1, s[i] - 1)) n_inclusion <- n_inclusion + 1L
  }
  es_evidence <- n_contain + n_inclusion
  if (es_evidence > 0 && es_evidence >= max(n_share_s, n_share_e)) {
    return(tibble(as_type = "ES", n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                  reason = sprintf("multi-junction cluster (n=%d): %d ES-supporting pair(s) [%d skip, %d inclusion]",
                                   n, es_evidence, n_contain, n_inclusion)))
  }
  if (n_share_s > 0 && n_share_s >= n_share_e) {
    as_type <- if (strand == "+") "AAS" else "ADS"
    return(tibble(as_type = as_type, n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                  reason = sprintf("multi-junction cluster: %d pair(s) share donor", n_share_s)))
  }
  if (n_share_e > 0) {
    as_type <- if (strand == "+") "ADS" else "AAS"
    return(tibble(as_type = as_type, n_junctions = n, confidence = "medium",
                  reason = sprintf("multi-junction cluster: %d pair(s) share acceptor", n_share_e)))
  }
  tibble(as_type = "complex", n_junctions = n, confidence = "low",
         reason = sprintf("complex cluster with %d junctions, no dominant pattern", n))
}
```

## 3c. Method C — transcript-pair classifier

The risk and nonrisk long-read isoforms are compared exon by exon in
transcription order. Non-overlapping first or last exons give AFE/ALE, an
internal exon with no counterpart gives ES (or MXE when both isoforms carry an
unmatched exon in the same region), matched exons with one differing boundary
give an alternative donor or acceptor, and an intron of one isoform contained in
an exon of the other gives intron retention. When several event types co-occur
the primary label follows the Song et al. convention (MXE with AFE/ALE becomes
MXE-AFE/MXE-ALE; otherwise a single accompanying event is subsumed under the
AFE, ALE or ES call).

```{r fn_classify_transcripts}
classify_transcript_pair <- function(exons_a, exons_b) {
  if (length(exons_a) == 0 || length(exons_b) == 0) {
    return(tibble(as_type = NA_character_, n_events = 0L, sub_events = NA_character_,
                  confidence = "missing"))
  }
  strand <- as.character(unique(strand(exons_a)))[1]
  if (strand == "-") {
    exons_a <- sort(exons_a, decreasing = TRUE); exons_b <- sort(exons_b, decreasing = TRUE)
  } else {
    exons_a <- sort(exons_a); exons_b <- sort(exons_b)
  }
  if (length(exons_a) == length(exons_b) &&
      all(start(exons_a) == start(exons_b)) && all(end(exons_a) == end(exons_b))) {
    return(tibble(as_type = "no_event", n_events = 0L, sub_events = NA_character_,
                  confidence = "high"))
  }

  events <- c()

  # AFE / ALE: terminal exons do not overlap
  first_a <- exons_a[1]; first_b <- exons_b[1]
  if (length(intersect(first_a, first_b)) == 0) events <- c(events, "AFE")
  last_a <- exons_a[length(exons_a)]; last_b <- exons_b[length(exons_b)]
  if (length(intersect(last_a, last_b)) == 0) events <- c(events, "ALE")

  # Internal exons: unmatched exons (ES / MXE) and boundary differences (ADS / AAS)
  internal_a <- if (length(exons_a) > 2) exons_a[2:(length(exons_a) - 1)] else GRanges()
  internal_b <- if (length(exons_b) > 2) exons_b[2:(length(exons_b) - 1)] else GRanges()
  hits_ab <- findOverlaps(internal_a, internal_b)
  hits_ba <- findOverlaps(internal_b, internal_a)
  unmapped_a <- setdiff(seq_along(internal_a), queryHits(hits_ab))
  unmapped_b <- setdiff(seq_along(internal_b), queryHits(hits_ba))
  if (length(unmapped_a) > 0 || length(unmapped_b) > 0) events <- c(events, "ES")

  # MXE: unmatched exons in both isoforms that do not overlap but lie within 5 kb
  if (length(unmapped_a) > 0 && length(unmapped_b) > 0) {
    mxe_pairs <- 0
    for (ia in unmapped_a) {
      ex_a <- internal_a[ia]
      for (ib in unmapped_b) {
        ex_b <- internal_b[ib]
        if (length(intersect(ex_a, ex_b)) == 0 &&
            min(abs(start(ex_a) - end(ex_b)), abs(start(ex_b) - end(ex_a))) < 5000) {
          mxe_pairs <- mxe_pairs + 1
        }
      }
    }
    if (mxe_pairs > 0) events <- c(events, "MXE")
  }

  if (length(hits_ab) > 0) {
    for (k in seq_along(hits_ab)) {
      ex_a <- internal_a[queryHits(hits_ab)[k]]
      ex_b <- internal_b[subjectHits(hits_ab)[k]]
      same_start <- start(ex_a) == start(ex_b)
      same_end   <- end(ex_a)   == end(ex_b)
      if (same_start && !same_end) {
        events <- c(events, if (strand == "+") "AAS" else "ADS")
      } else if (!same_start && same_end) {
        events <- c(events, if (strand == "+") "ADS" else "AAS")
      } else if (!same_start && !same_end) {
        events <- c(events, "complex")
      }
    }
  }

  # IR: an intron of one isoform fully covered by an exon of the other
  introns_a <- gaps(exons_a, start = min(start(exons_a)), end = max(end(exons_a)))
  introns_a <- introns_a[as.character(strand(introns_a)) == strand]
  introns_b <- gaps(exons_b, start = min(start(exons_b)), end = max(end(exons_b)))
  introns_b <- introns_b[as.character(strand(introns_b)) == strand]
  ir_ab <- countOverlaps(introns_a, exons_b, type = "within") > 0
  ir_ba <- countOverlaps(introns_b, exons_a, type = "within") > 0
  if (any(ir_ab) || any(ir_ba)) events <- c(events, "IR")

  events <- unique(events)
  if (length(events) == 0) {
    return(tibble(as_type = "complex", n_events = 0L, sub_events = NA_character_,
                  confidence = "low"))
  }

  primary <- if ("MXE" %in% events && "AFE" %in% events) {
    "MXE-AFE"
  } else if ("MXE" %in% events && "ALE" %in% events) {
    "MXE-ALE"
  } else if ("MXE" %in% events) {
    "MXE"
  } else if (length(events) == 1) {
    events
  } else if (all(events %in% c("AFE", "ALE"))) {
    paste(events, collapse = "+")
  } else if ("AFE" %in% events && length(events) <= 2) {
    "AFE"
  } else if ("ALE" %in% events && length(events) <= 2) {
    "ALE"
  } else if ("ES" %in% events && length(events) <= 2) {
    "ES"
  } else {
    "complex"
  }
  tibble(as_type = primary, n_events = length(events),
         sub_events = paste(events, collapse = ";"),
         confidence = if (length(events) == 1) "high" else "medium")
}
```

# 4. Apply the three classifiers to the CAD clusters

Method A runs on each risk/nonrisk junction pair, Method B on the complete
junction set of each CAD cluster, and Method C on each (risk, nonrisk) long-read
isoform pair. Strand is taken from the cluster identifier (`clu_NNNN_+/-`).

```{r apply_classifiers}
# ---- Method A ----
pairs_with_strand <- pairs_df %>% mutate(strand = str_sub(cluster_bed, -1, -1))
risk_coords <- parse_junction_key(pairs_with_strand$risk_junction)
names(risk_coords) <- c("risk_chr", "risk_start", "risk_end")
nonrisk_coords <- parse_junction_key(pairs_with_strand$nonrisk_junction)
names(nonrisk_coords) <- c("nonrisk_chr", "nonrisk_start", "nonrisk_end")
pairs_coords <- bind_cols(pairs_with_strand, risk_coords, nonrisk_coords)

method_a <- pairs_coords %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(cls = list(classify_junction_pair(
    risk_start, risk_end, nonrisk_start, nonrisk_end, strand,
    first_exon_gr = gencode_first_exon, last_exon_gr = gencode_last_exon,
    internal_exon_gr = internal_exon_gr, chr = risk_chr))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  unnest(cls) %>%
  as.data.frame()
# Base-R renaming avoids a dplyr/data.table name-resolution conflict on these columns
names(method_a)[names(method_a) == "as_type"]    <- "as_type_A"
names(method_a)[names(method_a) == "confidence"] <- "confidence_A"
names(method_a)[names(method_a) == "sub_event"]  <- "sub_event_A"
names(method_a)[names(method_a) == "reason"]     <- "reason_A"
method_a <- as_tibble(method_a)

# ---- Method B ----
sibs_for_topo <- siblings %>%
  mutate(strand = str_sub(cluster_bed, -1, -1)) %>%
  select(cluster_bed, junction_key, chrom = chrom, start, end, strand) %>%
  distinct()
method_b <- sibs_for_topo %>%
  group_by(cluster_bed) %>%
  group_modify(~ classify_cluster_topology(.x, first_exon_gr = gencode_first_exon,
                                           last_exon_gr = gencode_last_exon,
                                           internal_exon_gr = internal_exon_gr)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()
names(method_b)[names(method_b) == "as_type"]     <- "as_type_B"
names(method_b)[names(method_b) == "n_junctions"] <- "n_junctions_B"
names(method_b)[names(method_b) == "confidence"]  <- "confidence_B"
names(method_b)[names(method_b) == "reason"]      <- "reason_B"
method_b <- as_tibble(method_b)

# ---- Method C ----
iso_pairs_clean <- iso_pairs %>%
  filter(!is.na(risk_pb), !is.na(nonrisk_pb), risk_pb != nonrisk_pb) %>%
  distinct(gene_name, risk_pb, nonrisk_pb, .keep_all = TRUE)
method_c_results <- vector("list", nrow(iso_pairs_clean))
for (i in seq_len(nrow(iso_pairs_clean))) {
  ex_r  <- smc_exons_by_pb[[iso_pairs_clean$risk_pb[i]]]
  ex_nr <- smc_exons_by_pb[[iso_pairs_clean$nonrisk_pb[i]]]
  method_c_results[[i]] <- if (is.null(ex_r) || is.null(ex_nr)) {
    tibble(as_type = NA_character_, n_events = 0L, sub_events = NA_character_,
           confidence = "missing")
  } else {
    classify_transcript_pair(ex_r, ex_nr)
  }
}
method_c <- bind_cols(iso_pairs_clean, bind_rows(method_c_results)) %>% as.data.frame()
names(method_c)[names(method_c) == "as_type"]    <- "as_type_C"
names(method_c)[names(method_c) == "n_events"]   <- "n_events_C"
names(method_c)[names(method_c) == "sub_events"] <- "sub_events_C"
names(method_c)[names(method_c) == "confidence"] <- "confidence_C"
method_c <- as_tibble(method_c)
stopifnot("Method C table must carry cluster_bed" = any(!is.na(method_c$cluster_bed)))

message("Method A: "); print(table(method_a$as_type_A, useNA = "ifany"))
message("Method B: "); print(table(method_b$as_type_B, useNA = "ifany"))
message("Method C: "); print(table(method_c$as_type_C, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# 5. Consensus AS class per cluster

Method C is collapsed from isoform pairs to clusters by the modal call. The
consensus takes Method C when it makes a positive call, because the transcript
pair carries the most complete structural evidence; "complex" and "no_event"
from Method C are declinations rather than classifications and therefore do not
override a Method B call. Method B is used next, and Method A is the fallback.

```{r consensus}
method_c_per_cluster <- method_c %>%
  filter(!is.na(cluster_bed)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_bed) %>%
  summarise(
    as_type_C_modal = {
      tt <- sort(table(as_type_C), decreasing = TRUE)
      if (length(tt) == 0) NA_character_ else names(tt)[1]
    },
    as_type_C_all = paste(unique(as_type_C[!is.na(as_type_C)]), collapse = ";"),
    n_iso_pairs   = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

consensus <- method_a %>%
  select(cluster_bed, gene_name, risk_junction, nonrisk_junction, slope, direction,
         complement_source, as_type_A, confidence_A, reason_A) %>%
  left_join(method_b %>% select(cluster_bed, as_type_B, n_junctions_B, confidence_B, reason_B),
            by = "cluster_bed") %>%
  left_join(method_c_per_cluster, by = "cluster_bed") %>%
  mutate(
    C_usable = !is.na(as_type_C_modal) & !as_type_C_modal %in% c("complex", "no_event"),
    consensus_as_type = case_when(C_usable          ~ as_type_C_modal,
                                  !is.na(as_type_B) ~ as_type_B,
                                  TRUE              ~ as_type_A),
    consensus_source  = case_when(C_usable          ~ "C_transcript",
                                  !is.na(as_type_B) ~ "B_topology",
                                  TRUE              ~ "A_pair")) %>%
  select(-C_usable)

message("Consensus AS class per cluster:"); print(table(consensus$consensus_as_type, useNA = "ifany"))
print(table(consensus$consensus_source, useNA = "ifany"))
```

# 6. CAD versus non-CAD AS class distribution (Extended Data Fig. 5a)

The background comparison uses Method B for both groups, because Method B is the
only classifier that can be applied identically to CAD clusters and to the
thousands of non-CAD VSMC sQTL clusters (which have no risk/nonrisk pairing and
no paired isoforms). The χ² test on the overall distribution and the per-class
Fisher tests are recomputed from the exported table in script 10; they are
printed here for the log.

```{r cad_vs_noncad}
noncad_cluster_set <- str_extract(unique(general_sqtls$cluster_id), "clu_\\d+_[+-]")
noncad_cluster_set <- unique(noncad_cluster_set[!is.na(noncad_cluster_set)])

noncad_topo_input <- bed_all %>%
  filter(cluster_bed %in% noncad_cluster_set) %>%
  select(cluster_bed, junction_key, chrom, start, end, strand) %>%
  distinct()
method_b_noncad <- noncad_topo_input %>%
  group_by(cluster_bed) %>%
  group_modify(~ classify_cluster_topology(.x, first_exon_gr = gencode_first_exon,
                                           last_exon_gr = gencode_last_exon,
                                           internal_exon_gr = internal_exon_gr)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()
names(method_b_noncad)[names(method_b_noncad) == "as_type"]     <- "as_type_B"
names(method_b_noncad)[names(method_b_noncad) == "n_junctions"] <- "n_junctions_B"
names(method_b_noncad)[names(method_b_noncad) == "confidence"]  <- "confidence_B"
names(method_b_noncad)[names(method_b_noncad) == "reason"]      <- "reason_B"
method_b_noncad <- as_tibble(method_b_noncad)

combined_dist <- bind_rows(
  method_b        %>% mutate(group = "CAD sQTL")           %>% select(cluster_bed, as_type_B, group),
  method_b_noncad %>% mutate(group = "Non-CAD\nSMC sQTL")  %>% select(cluster_bed, as_type_B, group)
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(as_type_B))

dist_summary <- combined_dist %>%
  count(group, as_type_B) %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
# AS classes ordered by their frequency among CAD clusters
as_levels <- combined_dist %>% filter(group == "CAD sQTL") %>% count(as_type_B, sort = TRUE) %>%
  pull(as_type_B)
dist_summary$as_type_B <- factor(dist_summary$as_type_B, levels = as_levels)

cad_n    <- sum(combined_dist$group == "CAD sQTL")
noncad_n <- sum(combined_dist$group != "CAD sQTL")
message(sprintf("clusters classified: CAD = %d, non-CAD = %d", cad_n, noncad_n))

per_type_fisher <- map_dfr(unique(combined_dist$as_type_B), function(t) {
  cad_y    <- sum(combined_dist$group == "CAD sQTL" & combined_dist$as_type_B == t)
  noncad_y <- sum(combined_dist$group != "CAD sQTL" & combined_dist$as_type_B == t)
  ft <- fisher.test(matrix(c(cad_y, cad_n - cad_y, noncad_y, noncad_n - noncad_y),
                           nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
  tibble(as_type = t, cad_pct = round(cad_y / cad_n * 100, 1),
         noncad_pct = round(noncad_y / noncad_n * 100, 1),
         odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), p = ft$p.value)
}) %>%
  mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"), sig = sig_label(p_adj)) %>%
  arrange(p)
print(per_type_fisher)

chi_test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(xtabs(n ~ group + as_type_B, data = dist_summary)))
message(sprintf("chi-square on the overall distribution: X^2 = %.2f, df = %d, P = %.3g",
                chi_test$statistic, chi_test$parameter, chi_test$p.value))
```

# 7. Predicted protein consequence per junction pair (Fig. 4e)

Each risk/nonrisk junction is flagged as coding using the shared script-02
label, for CAD junctions from the CAD classification and for background
junctions from the non-CAD classification. Each pair is then assigned one
protein-consequence category in priority order: NMD candidate when either paired
isoform is predicted NMD, then exon skipping/inclusion, alternative splice site,
or alternative first/last exon when the event falls within an ORF, then a
noncoding splice event when neither junction is coding, and complex/other
otherwise. Script 10 collapses these pair-level calls to one dominant call per
long-read-captured junction.

```{r protein_effects}
cad_junction_status <- junction_annot %>%
  select(junction_key, in_cds_isoform, in_lr, coding_class)

noncad_unified_coding <- read_csv(OUT_NONCAD_JUNCTION_CODING, show_col_types = FALSE)
stopifnot("coding_class column expected in the non-CAD coding classification" =
            "coding_class" %in% names(noncad_unified_coding))
noncad_junction_status <- noncad_unified_coding %>%
  mutate(in_cds_isoform = coding_class %in% CODING_CLASS_KEEP) %>%
  select(junction_key, in_cds_isoform)

master_junction_annot <- bind_rows(
  cad_junction_status    %>% transmute(junction_key, in_cds = in_cds_isoform),
  noncad_junction_status %>% transmute(junction_key, in_cds = in_cds_isoform %in% TRUE)
) %>%
  distinct(junction_key, .keep_all = TRUE)

master_risk_df <- as.data.frame(master_junction_annot)
colnames(master_risk_df) <- c("risk_junction", "risk_in_cds")
master_nonrisk_df <- as.data.frame(master_junction_annot)
colnames(master_nonrisk_df) <- c("nonrisk_junction", "nonrisk_in_cds")

method_a_cds <- method_a %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(master_risk_df),    by = "risk_junction") %>%
  left_join(as_tibble(master_nonrisk_df), by = "nonrisk_junction") %>%
  filter(!is.na(as_type_A), as_type_A != "no_event") %>%
  as_tibble()

# NMD status of the paired isoforms, per cluster
stopifnot(all(c("risk_nmd", "nonrisk_nmd") %in% colnames(iso_pairs)))
cluster_nmd <- iso_pairs %>%
  group_by(cluster_bed) %>%
  summarise(any_nmd = any((risk_nmd %in% TRUE) | (nonrisk_nmd %in% TRUE)), .groups = "drop")

pair_effects <- method_a_cds %>%
  left_join(cluster_nmd, by = "cluster_bed") %>%
  mutate(
    any_cds = (risk_in_cds %in% TRUE) | (nonrisk_in_cds %in% TRUE),
    protein_effect = case_when(
      any_nmd %in% TRUE                        ~ "NMD candidate",
      as_type_A == "ES"  & any_cds             ~ "ES / inclusion in ORF",
      as_type_A %in% c("ADS", "AAS") & any_cds ~ "Alt splice site in ORF",
      as_type_A %in% c("AFE", "ALE") & any_cds ~ "AFE/ALE in ORF",
      !any_cds                                 ~ "Non-coding splice event",
      TRUE                                     ~ "Complex / other"))

message("Protein consequence per junction pair:"); print(count(pair_effects, protein_effect))
```
